title: Trust Document Asset Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trust:document asset_value_usd=*
| stats sum(asset_value_usd) as total_value, avg(asset_value_usd) as avg_value by document_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks document type values by total and average asset value across trust document events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `asset_value_usd` values for each trust document event and review total and average asset value by document type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total asset value.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which document type shows the biggest asset value numbers in your trust document data.
